title: One line of results.jsonl: one ContextQA run on one release of one bug

verdict.description: What ContextQA returned, e.g. REPRODUCED, NOT_REPRODUCED, NEEDS_INFO, INTERNAL_ERROR, FIXED, NOT_FIXED.

correct.description: verdict == expected. The scorer recomputes it and warns on a mismatch.

run_url.description: Public evidence page for this run (video, trace, steps).

contextqa_version.description: Release or commit of every ContextQA service used.

run_index.description: 0 for the first run; 0..N-1 for the consistency runs of the same input.
